text:
sara: Observed several OOM kills on eu-west-int8 canary hosts after the quant build swap at 02:10 UTC. Affected: 8/120 nodes. Error snippet below.
sara: ```
[2025-09-03T02:12:14Z] oom_kill: process runtime-worker pid=91234 rss=12.7G vm=24.1G
engine: engine-v3.12-int8 (sha: cc33aa)
```
marc: ugh. is this the int8 allocator change from the latest kernel path?
sara: appears correlated with new small-batch allocator and tighter mempool; reproducer on a pinned host shows same pattern.
jules: can we pin back to engine-v3.11-stable quickly? deploybot, what options do we have?
deploybot: Detected elevated OOMs on canary. Suggested actions: 1) Create emergency pin to engine-v3.11-stable, 2) Drain affected nodes, 3) Initiate rollback job. Run `curl -XPOST https://deploybot/release -d '{"bundle":"engine-v3.11-stable","action":"pin","ttl":10800}'`
lena: I'll run the pin now and start drains. marc, please prepare rollback command for full region if needed.
lena: `curl -XPOST https://deploybot/release -d '{"bundle":"engine-v3.11-stable","pin":"true","ttl":10800,"force":true}'`
deploybot: Pinning engine-v3.11-stable to eu-west pool. Pin created by lena. Affected canary slice reduced to 0%. Drains started on 8 hosts. Tracking: https://deploy/redwood/rel/1751004322 :white_check_mark:
omar: QA: reproducer confirms memory high on int8 path when batch_size=1 with kvcache disabled. Workaround: enable small-batch mem-limit flag `--mem-safety=relaxed` or use qv2-rr artifacts.
sara: we should avoid customer-facing flag changes. prefer pin/rollback. rolling back now.
nina - release: drafting a short incident blurb for release notes + internal channel. Will mention regression in int8 allocator causing OOM on small-batch workloads.
marc: rolling rollback to v3.11 across canary nodes now. `deploybot rollback --bundle engine-v3.11-stable --scope eu-west --why "OOMs on int8 path"`
deploybot: Rollback job started. ETA 6m. Notifying infra to monitor drain completion.
ops-bot: Alert cleared for engine-telemetry-canary-oom (eu-west) at 02:18 UTC.
sara: post-rollback smoke: P95 baseline 160ms -> post 159ms, no new OOMs in last 12m. kvcache healthy.
jules: good. follow-up actions: 1) revert allocator tweak in v3.12-int8 branch, 2) add mem-safety gate to CI for batch_size=1, 3) schedule a canary reattempt behind a feature flag. I'll file tickets.
omar: QA will attach the failure traces and minimal reproducer to the ticket. Also recommending a temporary quant-artifact fallback (qv2-rr) for next night window.
nina - release: I'll publish a short note: "Emergency rollback: engine-v3.12-int8 rolled back to v3.11-stable due to memory regressions on small-batch int8 paths. No customer impact observed. Follow-up testing planned." Want me to CC support?
lena: yes CC support+SRE. Also pin TTL is set to 3h to avoid accidental re-roll. We'll remove pin once a safe patch is validated.
sara: thanks. i'll own the postmortem and include the sample logs + timeline. tagging @channel for visibility. :rotating_light:
